conditional_unsat_checker.name: drat-trim
conditional_unsat_checker.requirement: Run only on a terminal full-input UNSAT proof; input auditing is not proof checking.

arithmetic: Python unbounded integers. C++ literals <=115104, clauses <=2576821, base offsets fewer than 16000000; uint32 offsets and int literals are safe. Stream buffers are about 1 MiB, with little-endian uint32 framing.
